staticStageRun.note: Separate timer-query run; pass boundaries may perturb tile rendering. Do not sum into a normal-game FPS estimate.

shortDrive.vehicleTimingScope: Vehicle.fixedUpdate only, excluding world.step, afterPhysics, HUD/audio; synthetic short straight drive, not full-lap target validation
shortDrive.note: Composite/output includes additional effect draws and is per invocation, not per frame; whole-frame GPU timing was not collected in this staged drive.

systemSnapshot.scope: Whole machine. Does not establish game-specific memory pressure or active swap as this run's bottleneck.
